notes.title: Patch 1,1
notes.content:
First fix of the game
We solved minor bugs, including the one that leave the shotgun without ammo.
We also lowered the difficulty of the second and third tier of challenges.
In the next update we will be including more shotgun skins, so if you have any skin you want us to make please leave a reference image or description here.
